task_contract.causal_rule: a waveform occurs only when a trigger arrives above the slow-evidence threshold and outside refractory state

controls.budget_matching: nearest width is recorded, and relative parameter error is reported
controls.optimizer: AdamW with equal weight decay, gradient clipping, epoch and update schedule
controls.learning_rate_calibration: each architecture receives the same two-rate calibration on medium difficulty and the large budget
controls.data: identical fixed train and validation arrays for every architecture within a difficulty
controls.screening: all ten sketches receive one paired seed over the complete capacity x difficulty grid

metrics: slow, voltage, recovery and mean state NRMSE

hit_selection.rule: rank the large-budget screen jointly by spike F1, event RMSE, peak MAE, slow NRMSE and false spikes
hit_selection.diversity: select at most one winner per mechanism group before taking the best three groups
hit_selection.replication: the three selected leads receive two additional paired model seeds across the full capacity x difficulty grid

promotion_rule.scope: three-seed mean at large budget on hard difficulty
promotion_rule.authorization: a passing hit proceeds only to internal mechanism deconvolution, not directly to a Hay claim

failure_rules: failure on easy difficulty prunes the family from threshold-transition use under this training contract
capacity improvement without hard-difficulty transition success supports scaling sensitivity but does not promote
if no family passes hard promotion thresholds, separate objective/exposure capability from architecture before a Hay run
